system.description:
Mark a Stress to activate a heavy
survival exo-rig built. While active,
hydraulic braces lock into place,
cutting tools unfold, armor plates shift,
hazard filters overclock, and your gear
enters full breach mode. You gain the
following benefits:
When you succeed on an attack or
Interface Roll, add +10 to damage.
When you deal enough damage to
defeat a creature within Close
range, you strip usable plating,
siphon a power cell, or trigger
emergency repair foam and clear an
Armor Slot.
You can’t be Restrained.
Before you make an action roll, you
must spend a Hope. If you can’t, the rig
overheats, locks, or burns through its
emergency charge, and you revert to
your normal state.
